unit: Algebra · §4. Linear equations in one unknown
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Steps: open brackets, move unknowns to one side and numbers to the other, collect like terms, divide by the coefficient.
stages.headlineEnglish: Steps: open brackets, move unknowns to one side and numbers to the other, collect like terms, divide by the coefficient.

stages.headline: With fractional coefficients, multiply both sides by a common multiple of the denominators.
stages.headlineEnglish: With fractional coefficients, multiply both sides by a common multiple of the denominators.

stages.headline: Finally, check the root by substituting it into the original equation.
stages.headlineEnglish: Finally, check the root by substituting it into the original equation.
